        # southeast_asia-03: 1329 年冬牛吼（黑泰人的沱江政权）进犯大越西北，太上皇陈明宗亲征；1337 年下半年明宗又派兴孝王攻沱江牛吼，杀其首领车奋——开局时双方处于这两次战事之间。 (中)
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:DAI country_exists = c:CBK } c:DAI = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s37_southeast_asia_nguu_hong target = c:CBK } } c:CBK = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s37_southeast_asia_nguu_hong target = c:DAI } } }
        # southeast_asia-04: 马达班（汉达瓦底）1330 年正式摆脱素可泰的宗主权；素可泰视和约作废，1330–1331 年出兵进攻被决定性击败，而此前素可泰已把土瓦以南的丹那沙林海岸夺回（原版由素可泰的附庸 TSM 表示）。 (中)
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PEG country_exists = c:SUK } c:PEG = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s37_southeast_asia_martaban_war target = c:SUK } } c:SUK = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s37_southeast_asia_martaban_war target = c:PEG } } }
        # southeast_asia-05: 1327 年彬牙劫掠若开的兰里岛；1334 年 1 月若开王敏底越过若开山脉劫掠彬牙属地德耶谬，把总督敏信梭一家掳往朗耶，直到约 1343 年才放回彬牙。 (中)
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ARK country_exists = c:PIN } c:ARK = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s37_southeast_asia_thayet_raid target = c:PIN } } c:PIN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_s37_southeast_asia_thayet_raid target = c:ARK } } }
        # glh_ulus-29: 1337.4.1 开局当日初始化术赤兀鲁思凝聚度（85）、第一阶段状态及五翼动态国名（含克里米亚万户）。 (高)
        oe_ghh_init = yes
        # chg_ulus-16: 1337.4.1 开局当日统一确认 17 个察合台阿米尔（含 FRG/OTR/BSB）为 oe_chg_amir，并初始化三新万户名称与边屯冬储。 (高)
        oe_chgu_init = yes
        # v210_khm-03: 1337.4.1 开局当日将 JAL(19)/GRG(10)/TIB(14)/MAL(13) 的既定附庸分别改制为专属附庸体系，并初始化四大体系威权变量。 (高)
        oe_vs2_init = yes
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while var:oe_s37_mono_watch lasts (24 months): once a theme exists in historical
# region 12 (Thessaly), Michael Monomachos, its governor in 1337, takes it over.
oe_s37_setup_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = character:oe_s37_michael_monomachos
            character:oe_s37_michael_monomachos = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no owner ?= c:BYZ }
            any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 12 }
        }
        character:oe_s37_michael_monomachos = { save_scope_as = oe_s37_mono }
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 12 } save_scope_as = oe_s37_ths }
        scope:oe_s37_ths = { ruler ?= { save_scope_as = oe_s37_prev } }
        scope:oe_s37_mono = { move_country = scope:oe_s37_ths }
        scope:oe_s37_ths = { set_new_ruler = scope:oe_s37_mono }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_s37_ths = { exists = ruler ruler = scope:oe_s37_mono } }
            scope:oe_s37_mono = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } } add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } reset_ruler_title = {} }
            scope:oe_s37_prev ?= {
                if = { limit = { is_alive = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_s37_mono } has_trait = oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } remove_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI }
                if = { limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no NOT = { this = scope:oe_s37_mono } } move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
            }
            remove_variable = oe_s37_mono_watch
        }
    }
}

# Test helpers (console, BYZ scope).
oe_s37_test_mono = { set_variable = { name = oe_s37_mono_watch months = 24 } oe_s37_setup_monthly = yes }
